scope: Public official entry and launcher interface only; no protected module, generated scene, layout values, or object truth inspected.
findings: Official entry passes --seed unchanged to launcher.
Builder --no-randomize is intentional: scene instance is assigned by protected initialization, which receives the seed. Do not remove the flag or bypass the official entry.
Changing official --seed is the interface for future multi-seed trials; no new seed has been run.
